buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bid pre-qualification criteria for OTE: i. Firm should be established for supply of any type of Rubber Item at any DPSU/ Govt Department/ Liste d Company. ii. If the firm is established for any type of Rubber Item at O F Bhusawal need not to submit any proof be ing established. If the firm is established for any type of Rubber Item in other than Ordnance Factory Bhus awal in that case firm has to submit supporting documents in this regard (i.e. Supply Order copy, Tax Invoi ce/ proof of successful supply/ successfully execution of supply order, Drawings). iii. Those firms who have not supplied at least 50% quantity against existing Supply Order for Bid item i. e. Stud for Carrier 13A/16A on Tender Opening Date are not eligible to participate in the instant bid.

iv. The Firm shall have rubber product manufacturing facilities like Mastication, Mixing, Curing , Molding etc. v. The firm shall have in-house Testing facilities like Shore Hardness, UTS, Impurity, Muffle Furnace etc. vi. Firm shall have qualified experienced team from domain knowledge. vii. Firm shall submit documents in proof of above information mentioned para (ii) to (vi). viii. Non-compliance of above terms and conditions may result in termination of participation and offer o f the Firm will be liable for rejection. Bids without submission of above supporting documents will be sum marily rejected and no further correspondence in this regard will be done. This may be strictly adhere to. BIDDER UNDERTAKING I have read the clause mentioned in ATC in this bid and given compliance of the following clauses : Specification Delivery Period Option Clause Inspection Clause Bidder Financial Standing Non-Involvement in Cartel Formation: We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cartel wi th other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIMITED , ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. Material: Pre inspection report, Guarantee/warranty certificate and Test Certificate should be sent along wi th supply. The material will be checked by Govt. lab/NABL accredited lab and the results of the lab will be t he sole criteria for acceptance of the item. Loading/Unloading: Offer should be for Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. Loading & Unloading of Goods at OFB H premises will be done by the supplier. Product Delivery: a.Each package/bags shall be suitable marked with identification marking to enable satisfactory referenc e with the corresponding Invoice and GeM contract number. Marking on Each package/bags must contains reference Invoice number. GeM contract number, Qty, Item description, Outer dimension, volume and gros s weight in Units should as per contract. If identification marking on each package/bags is not available or not matching with reference Invoice Qty then firm is responsible delay to acceptance of material or for any short supply. Every Gunny/Plastic/Packaging bag containing the material/component should be sufficient s trength/strong enabling to bear standard way of handling and not to tear easily. b.Supplier must generate Physical Invoice Qty as per Lot wise Qty of stagger delivery period mention in r espective contract. GeM invoice to be generated at time of delivery as per physical invoice Qty within deliv ery period. If supplier get any difficulties to generate the GeM Invoice within delivery period then contact t o GeM help desk to resolve the issue. c.Each Consignment should be Supply with following documents in 1. Physical Tax Invoice 2. GeM Invoice copy (Qty should be matched with Tax Invoice Qty) 3. Test Report (NABL or as per GeM Contract T&C) 4. Guarantee/Warranty 5. Pre-Inspection Report d.In case of Supplier has failed to provide the above mentioned documents along with each Consignment then material will not be taken inside the Factory. Guarantee/Warranty: The stores supplied against the order shall be deemed to have been warranted by th e contractor against deterioration/defective material and workmanship and performance for a period of 12 months from the date of receipt of stores at our end and any material found rejected/defective during the Guarantee/Warranty period, the same should be replaced free of cost.

Payment Terms: Payment terms shall be 100% payment through NEFT/RTGS only for accepted material wi thin 30 days for the date of receipt of material or submission of bills/documents whichever is later Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms and Condition : A. Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods B. Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: 1. Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises : Nil 2. Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores : (ED O F Bhusawal or His Authori sed Rep.) C. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in th e Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. D. Earnest Money Deposit: Firms are requested to go through the bid and submit the Earnest Money Depo sit in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt in favor Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory Bhusawal payable a t Bhusawal. The validity of Fixed Deposit Receipt should be Six months from the date of publication of bid . It may be ensured that the hard copy of Fixed Deposit Receipt should be reached to O.F. Bhusawal prior to bid opening date. E. Earnest Money Deposit exemption criteria:Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) having UAM number as d efined in MSE Procurement Policy issued by Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) o r are registered with the Central Purchase Organisation or the concerned Ministry or Department (including OFs) or Startups as recognised by Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP), irrespective of the store for which they are registered. EMD is also not required from Central PSUs. F. Forms of Earnest Money Deposit and Performance Bank Guarantee: Successful Bidder has to submit the Performance Security (5% of Supply Order Value) in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG w hich is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory, Bhusawal A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of. G. Supply of Material: The items will be supplied in its original packing material and the packing material will not be returned. Each Consignment should be Supply with following documents in (1) Physical Tax Inv oice, (2) GeM Invoice copy (Qty should be matched with Tax Invoice Qty), (3) Test Report (NABL or as per GeM Contract T&C) (4) Guarantee/Warranty & (5) Pre-Inspection Report. In case of Supplier has failed to provide the above mentioned documents along with each Consignment the n material will not be taken inside the Factory. H.For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procur ement Manual available of YIL site: yantraindia.co.in/en/e-library. I. For any query please contact on - Email- ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in, Phone : 02582-222431,222552, 222907 . Ext. No. 241. .
